title: Find a common denominator
text: To perform the operation $$\frac{1}{x+h}-\frac{1}{x}$$, we find a common denominator. That common denominator is the product of the two denominators $$x\left(x+h\right)$$.

title: Find a common denominator
text: To create an expression with common denominators, we multiply the first term by $$\frac{x}{x}$$ and the second term by $$\frac{x+h}{x+h}$$. \n $$\frac{1}{x+h} \frac{x}{x}-\frac{1}{x} \frac{x+h}{x+h}=\frac{x}{x\left(x+h\right)}-\frac{x+h}{x\left(x+h\right)}$$

title: Add numerators
text: Apply the rule for adding or subracting fraction with a common denominator: \n $$\frac{a}{c}\pm \frac{b}{c}=\frac{a\pm b}{c}$$.

title: Turn denominator into a fraction
text: Write $$\frac{\frac{1}{x+h}-\frac{1}{x}}{h}=\frac{\frac{-h}{x(x+h)}}{h}=\frac{\frac{-h}{x(x+h)}}{\frac{h}{1}}.$$ Here, we used the fact tha $$h=\frac{h}{1}$$.

title: Divide fractions
text: To divide by a fraction, we multiply by the reciprocal.
